column5: Re-measured the header band only, to settle the stroke clause vverify.predict.tsv:185 carried from the wave-60 worked example that wave 61 had already corrected on line 187 for the 768 board. get_design_context on Header-mobile 10597:73443 DECLARES gap-[12px] pb-[12px] pt-[var(--s-1,5,6px)] px-[19px] over a 1px border; get_metadata reports the frame itself as 375x82 and puts Frame 1185 10597:73447 at (19,6) 337x36 and nav 10597:73471 at (19,54) 337x16, so 54 == 6 + 36 + 12 and 82 - (54 + 16) == 12 - each declared padding confirmed a second time by a child position rather than by a tail inferred from subtracting the children, which balances by construction on any auto-layout frame. The horizontal axis settles it independently: 19 + 337 + 19 == 375, where a stroke counted on top would have left that row 335. ARITHMETIC 6 + 36 + 12 + 16 + 12 = 82 = the frame's own reported height. EQUAL, so the stroke is painted INSIDE the 82 and CSS pays (padding - 1) + border.
